standards.document: 10 CFR 50 Appendix B and NRC RG 1.28 (Rev. 6)
standards.description: QA criteria for design and construction (Appendix B, 18 criteria) and the NRC guide on acceptable QA programs. RG 1.28 Rev. 6 (2023) endorses ASME NQA-1-2017, -2019 and -2022 with exceptions and clarifications, not NQA-1-2024 or -2026 (see entry 30 for NQA-1). Appendix B is also part of 10 CFR Part 50 (entry 1); it is kept as its own entry because reports cite the QA set (Appendix B + RG 1.28 + NQA-1) as a unit.
standards.relevance_to_nuclear_power_generation: Essential for QA implementation.

overlaps_with.note: The Appendix B half of this entry duplicates text that is part of entry 1 (10 CFR Part 50). Kept separate because reports cite 'QA' (Appendix B + RG 1.28) as one item; ASME NQA-1 is entry 30.

standards.document: ASME NQA-1-2026, Quality Assurance Requirements for Nuclear Facility Applications
standards.description: QA requirements for the whole nuclear-facility life cycle: Part I (basic requirements 1 to 18, matching the 18 criteria of 10 CFR 50 Appendix B), Part II (requirements for specific work activities), Part III (guidance). Stated applicable to large LWRs, SMRs and advanced reactors. 2026 edition listed Aug. 2026 as the latest; NQA-1-2024 (July 2024) is the predecessor. NRC RG 1.28 Rev. 6 endorses only NQA-1-2017, -2019 and -2022.
standards.relevance_to_nuclear_power_generation: Essential for QA implementation (the consensus standard behind Appendix B and 10 CFR 830 QA programs). The edition an NRC licensee may cite is the one endorsed in RG 1.28, currently older than the latest published edition.
standards.format_of_data: HTML landing pages (paywalled); sold as PDF and print (ASME lists about $415). Editions and status taken from search-engine listings (vendor stores, ANSI/ASME titles); the ASME and ANSI pages were not opened directly
standards.update_tracking: Edition year is in the name. Publisher pages: https://www.asme.org/codes-standards/find-codes-standards/quality-assurance-requirements-for-nuclear-facility-applications and https://webstore.ansi.org/standards/asme/asmenqa2026 (a later edition will get a new page, e.g. .../asmenqa2028); committee page: https://cstools.asme.org/csconnect/CommitteePages.cfm?Committee=O10500000. NRC acceptance: RG list https://www.nrc.gov/regulations-legislation/regulatory-guides-by-division/division-1---power-reactors (RG 1.28 Rev. 6 endorses -2017/-2019/-2022; watch for Rev. 7) and https://www.nrc.gov/reactors/new-reactors/how-we-regulate/oversight/quality-assurance/qual-assure-safety
